instruction: I need to set up the PyTorch Lightning framework for deep learning experiments. Please clone 'https://github.com/Lightning-AI/pytorch-lightning' into the /home/user directory and install the package following their quick start documentation.

metadata.explanation: Task variation testing PyTorch Lightning framework setup. Evaluator verifies that the pytorch_lightning module can be imported and version can be printed without errors. The check_include_exclude metric ensures no error strings appear in output.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction explicitly requires cloning repository into /home/user directory, but evaluator only verifies successful module import
User could satisfy evaluator by running 'pip install pytorch-lightning' without cloning, which would pass verification but fail instruction requirements
The evaluator correctly verifies installation success (importable module without errors) but misses the clone location requirement
Getter logic is correct: get_vm_command_error executes Python import test and returns error stream
Metric logic is correct: check_include_exclude with exclude rules properly verifies absence of error strings (Error:, ModuleNotFoundError, ImportError)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add additional verification step to check if /home/user/pytorch-lightning directory exists (e.g., using vm_command to test 'test -d /home/user/pytorch-lightning')
Add verification that /home/user/pytorch-lightning/.git directory exists to confirm it was cloned (not just pip installed)
Consider using compound evaluator with partial credit: 0.5 for successful import, 0.5 for correct clone location
Alternative: Simplify instruction to only require installation (remove clone location requirement) if cloning is not essential
